scope: All 60 actual MP4 masters and 240 actual translated M4A teaching tracks, source files unchanged.
user_overrides_preserved: Four selectable translated coaching tracks preserve English dialogue

rules.loudness_tolerance: tools/video/assemble/plan.mjs:13-14 and 201-204; -14 LUFS +/-1; true peak QA ceiling -0.5 dBTP (-1 target +0.5 tolerance)

method.audio: Every full audio stream decoded by ffmpeg ebur128=peak=true to null; no sample-only measurements and no transcoding of user files
method.gop: Every video packet inspected by ffprobe; key-packet AVCC NAL units read at packet offsets, all key packets checked for IDR (NAL type 5); x264 SEI settings read from each file
method.sha256: All media SHA-256 computed, raw ffprobe and ebur128 log per file in media_logs
caveats: This is a technical media audit, not listening/transcription or pedagogical review.
Full video pixel decoding and visual frame review were not done by this audit; full audio decoding and all packet metadata were.
AAC reported bit_rate is an observed average, not proof of requested encoder bitrate. All observed values are recorded; custom source currently requests 64k, rather than channel 384k.
The name of x264 tune is not retained in bitstream; source requests stillimage and SEI psy/deblock settings are retained.
